title: Si fuera tan amable: cortesía y mitigación pragmática
goal: Employ hypothetical conditionals as pragmatic mitigating devices to formulate diplomatic requests, negotiations, and gentle refusals.
grammar: Fórmulas de cortesía y atenuación condicional

sections.title: Unit 9: Conditionals I — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 9 (Conditionals I: Potential Scenarios). Mastering hypothetical conditionals enables you to explore alternatives, negotiate terms, and calibrate diplomatic courtesy.
In this lesson, we study si fuera tan amable: cortesía y mitigación pragmática, establishing rigorous command of imperfect subjunctive and conditional correlatives.

items: Employ hypothetical conditionals as pragmatic mitigating devices to formulate diplomatic requests, negotiations, and gentle refusals.
Incorporate advanced negotiation vocabulary (el protocolo, afable).
